title: Thomas Edison, the Inventor
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor from the United States. He was born in 1847 in Ohio. When he was a boy, he did not study at school for long, so his mother taught him at home. Edison loved to do experiments in his own laboratory.

Edison wanted to make a better light bulb. Many people had tried before him, but his bulbs lasted much longer. He also invented the phonograph, which could record and play sound. During his life, he received more than 1,000 patents.

questions.text: Which invention could record and play sound?
What can we infer about Edison from the passage?
options: He was lazy about his work
He was patient and kept trying
He stopped working after his first failure

questions.text: Why were Edison's long-lasting light bulbs useful to people?
options: They helped people see at night
They were used to cook food

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison był słynnym wynalazcą ze Stanów Zjednoczonych. Urodził się w 1847 roku w stanie Ohio. Kiedy był chłopcem, nie uczył się w szkole długo, więc jego matka uczyła go w domu. Edison lubił robić eksperymenty we własnym laboratorium.

Edison chciał zrobić lepszą żarówkę. Wielu ludzi próbowało przed nim, ale jego żarówki trwały dużo dłużej. Wynalazł też fonograf, który mógł nagrywać i odtwarzać dźwięk. W ciągu swojego życia otrzymał ponad 1000 patentów.
